items.paraphrase: Class 2/3 flat entrance doors may be up to 20 m from a single exit at the egress level; otherwise 6 m to an exit or to a point with two escape directions.
items.note: read 2026-11-14; dwelling-door distance 20 m to a single exit, 6 m to an exit or two-direction point; common-area points 20 m

items.paraphrase: Class 5-9 floors: no point beyond 20 m from an exit or two-direction point, and the distance to at least one exit must not exceed 40 m.
items.note: read 2026-11-14; 20 m to single exit / two-way point, 40 m to the nearest of alternative exits; 30 m for single exit at access level (Class 5/6)

items.paraphrase: Habitable rooms in Class 2 and Class 4 parts need glazed area of at least a tenth of the floor area (roof lights 3 percent).
On an accessway, a multi-leaf doorway needs one leaf giving at least 850 mm clear opening.
items.note: read 2026-11-14; value stated in NCC text, detail in AS 1428.1

items.clause: Part 3, cl. 3.3 (internal corridors serving a doorway under cl. 3.1): min clear width 1000 mm between wall surfaces; also 1.1(2)(a)(iv) access path 1000 mm
items.paraphrase: Dwelling internal corridors need at least 1000 mm clear between finished wall surfaces; the step-free access path is also at least 1000 mm wide.
items.note: read 2026-11-14: codemark.abcb.gov.au LHDS 2022 preview PDF; 1000 mm confirmed for dwellings via Livable Housing Design Standard (preview edition), not AS 1428.1 (paid); NCC passing-space rule not re-read

items.paraphrase: Wheelchair turning space around 1540 mm diameter; NCC D4D4(3)(b) requires turning spaces within 2 m of dead ends and every 20 m.
items.note: unverifiable_free: AS 1428.1 is paid; the free Livable Housing Design Standard preview has no turning-circle figure; secondary summaries give a 2070x1540 mm rectangle for 180 degree turns, a 1540 mm circle was not confirmed

items.clause: cl. 1.1(2)(a)(ii) and (4): step-free access path max gradient 1:14; ramp length caps 9 m at 1:14
items.paraphrase: Step-free dwelling access path has max gradient 1:14; total ramping length is limited to 9 m at 1:14, more at flatter slopes.
items.note: read 2026-11-14: codemark.abcb.gov.au LHDS 2022 preview PDF; 1:14 for dwelling access ramps, not read in AS 1428.1 itself (paid)

items.paraphrase: Office (Class 5) compartment limit depends on construction type: 8000 m2 Type A, 5500 Type B, 3000 Type C; a volume limit also applies.
items.note: read 2026-11-14; Type C shown (most conservative); Type A 8000 m2 / 48000 m3. No Class 2/3 row in the table

items.paraphrase: A fully sprinklered Class 5-9 building with perimeter vehicle access may exceed the table limits, up to 18000 m2 and 108000 m3 under this concession.
items.note: read 2026-11-14; larger buildings also allowed if sprinklered and with access

items.paraphrase: Riser of a required stair between 115 and 190 mm.
Going at least 250 mm in public stairs, 240 mm in private stairs, maximum 355 mm; 2R+G between 550 and 700 mm.
items.note: read 2026-11-14; private (within a dwelling unit) 240 mm

items.paraphrase: Exit width of at least 1 m for up to 100 occupants, growing in steps with occupant numbers.
items.note: read 2026-11-14; clear of handrail projections per D2D11
read 2026-11-14 at ncc.abcb.gov.au Table 11.2.2a (non-spiral stairs: riser 190 mm max, going 240 mm min)
read 2026-11-14 at ncc.abcb.gov.au Table 11.2.2a (non-spiral stairs: riser 190 mm max, going 240 mm min)

items.paraphrase: Habitable rooms (not kitchens) in Class 2/3/4 part: minimum ceiling height 2.4 m; kitchens, corridors 2.1 m.
Rooms in Class 5-8 buildings generally need 2.4 m; corridors 2.1 m.
items.note: read 2026-11-14; offices not named but fall under the general rule
